dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Isn't that Varka and Glory? Don't tell Paimon Godwin's run away again?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Miss Glory, in accordance with Godwin's personal wishes and the need to keep a small force stationed in Nod-Krai, I'm afraid he'll be away for some time longer.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: The reason I've come to see you today is to inform you of the situation and to read this letter on Godwin's behalf.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Ahem... "My Lady Glory, at this very moment, I am writing to you over a glass of fine wine."

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: My Lady...?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: "Although the Knights of Favonius's expedition has ended, my personal journey continues still..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhm... This letter from "Godwin"...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shh, let's see where this is going.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: "...Therefore, I have decided to stand fast in Nod-Krai, and to continue fighting for the defense of my beloved Mondstadt!"

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: "I understand this decision may hurt you, and no apology can undo the pain I cause... But please, believe me when I say, my love runs deep and true."

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: ..."Deep and true"... Thank you, Grand Master Varka, for bringing me this letter. Godwin's resolve... I can feel it clearly.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Though being apart may be painful, if this is his decision, I'll wait as long as it takes... May the thousand winds protect you, Godwin...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Haha, don't worry... The situation there is safe now. I'm sure that Godwin will be back before you know it.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Well then, Miss Glory, I have other matters to attend to. Farewell for now.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Varka ushers you away...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's the deal with that letter? Did Godwin really go to Nod-Krai?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: He did indeed... *sigh* Where should I start? After my little "refresher course," I gave him one day to make his final decision...

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Grand Master, I think... I think I've made up my mind... I can't keep lying to her...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Is that so? Good. I may have said that the Knights of Favonius do not interfere with personal matters — so long as the decisions you make do not impugn the honor of the Knights...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: But I must say... Deep down, I was hoping this would be the path you chose. You don't look so good, though — rough night, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: You can say that again... Even though I made my decision, I wasn't sure of the best way to tell her. In the end, I stayed up all night working on this letter.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Sure didn't skimp on the prep, huh? C'mon, let me take a look...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry... Glory... I must confess my sins..." Haha... Well, I guess that's passable.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: "A hypocrite like myself deserves no forgiveness... much less the honor to remain by your side..." ...Huh? What's all this...?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: "I don't deserve your forgiveness... Perhaps you deserve someone better..." What the heck is this nonsense!? Is this your attempt at taking responsibility?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: G—Grand Master! Please let me explain! I... I've carefully thought this through...

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: If I tell her more lies — even if she never finds out the truth — I would only grow to despise myself more... Could someone like that truly make her happy?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: But if I confess everything... I'm sure she'll forgive me and accept me, as despicable as I've been... Because she's so gentle, so understanding...

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: But I can't bring myself to accept her kindness in such a shameful way! I wouldn't be able to forgive myself!

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: I've thought it all through — what decision to make, what the consequences will be, and... I think I could bear it all...

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: But even then, no matter what I choose... I'd never be able to forgive myself! I—I... *sob*...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: *sigh* In this state, even if I forced you to face her, I doubt it would do either of you much good.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: ...After all these years of patrolling and fighting on the outskirts of Mondstadt, you've covered no less ground than the expedition itself. C'mon, how has your resolve gotten so weak?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Perhaps... I was beyond saving from the moment I told that first lie to avoid the shame...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Hah... Well, if you can't forgive yourself for your lies, then why not turn them into truths? Embark on your own "expedition"!

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: My own... expedition?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Go to Nod-Krai and temper your resolve. They're short-handed there at the moment anyway, so consider this your punishment for not returning to duty on time.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Nod-Krai... the expedition's final destination?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Go and learn from the expedition forces there what it truly means to be an upstanding knight! Naturally, before your character-building begins, you'll need to resolve your affairs in Mondstadt first.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Go fetch a pen and paper and write a new letter. This time, I'll dictate, and you transcribe. I don't wanna read any more of this spineless drivel.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Ahem... "My Lady Glory, at this very moment, I am writing to you over a glass of fine wine."

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Uhm... Grand Master, we don't usually address each other like this... And if I'm going to write about wine... Uhm... Well... How about, "The scent of wine on the wind reminds me of you, no matter how far apart—"

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: There's no need for you to add anything — just write exactly what I say! Now, "Although the Knights of Favonius's expedition has ended, my personal journey continues still..."

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: ...Uhm... A—Alright... I've written so many letters, maybe it's time I took notes from someone else...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: "...to continue fighting for the defense of my beloved Mondstadt!" Haha, I really outdid myself with that ending!

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Y—Yes, indeed! Haha... B—But... Uhm... I still want to apologize to Glory, at least in some way.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Huh? Alright, let me think... You could add a postscript...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "I understand this decision may hurt you, and no apology can undo the pain I cause... But please, believe me when I say, my love for you runs deep and true."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon knew it! Something felt off about that whole letter — except the last bit... But isn't this just a different kind of lie?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Hmm? You think so? The letter genuinely was "written" by Godwin himself, and he really has gone to Nod-Krai now. As for getting separated from the expedition... Well, the letter didn't mention anything about that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh! So Paimon guesses you didn't "technically" lie...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Besides, if Godwin were to face Glory now, it would leave an indelible mark on both their hearts... They'd never be able to truly move on.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: He made an undeniable mistake, one for which he must make amends through his actions — both for the Knights of Favonius and for Glory.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Godwin has promised me that once his "expedition" is over, he will personally confess everything to Glory.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: ...As for me, I pray he won't waste this opportunity to become a true knight once again. But that's an understanding we have as fellow Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, at least he's moving in the right direction...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Though... if even we can tell something's off with that letter, surely Glory will know exactly who wrote each line too...)

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: ...Don't forget to keep your promise, Godwin.
